questions.question: If '-' means '÷', '÷' means '-', '+' means '×' and '×' means '+', then which of the following equation is true?
questions.solution:
** Symbols **

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
×

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning **

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 

1) 11 × 2 + 9 - 3 = 15

On changing symbols

11 + 2 × 9 ÷ 3

11 + 2 × 3

11 + 6

**= 17**

Hence, this equation is false.

2) 14 + 2 - 4 × 6 = 14

On changing symbols

14 × 2 ÷ 4 + 6

14 × 0.5 + 6

7 + 6

**= 13**

Hence, this equation is false.

3) 19 + 2 × 6 - 3 = 40 

On changing symbols

19 × 2 + 6 ÷ 3

19 × 2 + 2

38 + 2

**= 40**

Hence, this equation is *true*.

4) 9 - 6 + 12 × 2 = 22

On changing symbols

9 ÷ 6 × 12 + 2

1.5 × 12 + 2

18 + 2

**= 20**

Hence, this equation is false.

Clearly, ‘19 + 2 × 6 - 3 = 40’ equation is true

questions.question: If 27 @ 22 = 25 and 39 @ 33 = 36, then 25 @ 22 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is that both the numbers are subtracted and square the value of resultant.

27 @ 22 = 25

→ (27 - 22) = 5

(5)² = 25

39 @ 33 = 36

→ (39 - 33) = 6

(6)² = 36

Similarly;

25 @ 22 = ?

(25 - 22) = 3

(3)² = 9

Hence, correct answer is 9.

questions.question: If 465781P is completely divisible by 12, then what is the value of P?
questions.solution:
If 465781P is completely divisible by 12 then it must be divisible by 3 and 4.

Now number is divisible by 3 when the sum of digits is divisible by 3 i.e. 4 + 6 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + P = 31 + P must be divisible by 3.

Also the last digit can be 2 or 6, then only number will be divisible by 4.

If P = 2, then 33 is divisible by 3 but when P = 6, then 37 is not divisible by 3.

∴ P = 2.

Three taps A, B and C can fill a tank in 10, 12 and 15 hours respectively. If all the taps are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.solution:
Part of tank filled by tap A in 1 hour = 1/10

Part of tank filled by tap B in 1 hour = 1/12

Part of tank filled by tap C in 1 hour = 1/15

⇒ Part of tank filled by all three taps in 1 hour

= 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/15 = 15/60 = 1/4

∴ The complete tank will be filled in 4 hours.

questions.question: Two pipes P and Q, when opened alone can fill the tank in 20 and 30 hours respectively. If both pipes are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.solution:
Part of tank filled by pipe P in 1 hour = 1/20

Part of tank filled by pipe Q in 1 hour = 1/30

⇒ Tank filled by both pipes in 1 hour = 1/20 + 1/30 = 5/60 = 1/12

∴ Complete tank will be filled by both in 12 hours.

questions.question: The length and breadth of a rectangle are in the ratio 8 : 3. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 220 cm, then what is the length of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of Length and breadth of rectangle = 8 : 3

Perimeter of rectangle = 220cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

where l → length of the rectangle

b → breadth of the rectangle

**Calculation:**

Let the Length and breadth of the rectangle be 8x and 3x

Perimeter = 220

⇒ 2(l + b) = 220

⇒ l + b = 110

⇒ 8x + 3x = 110

⇒ 11x = 110

⇒ x = 110/11 = 10

∴ Length = 8x = 8 × 10 = 80 cm

questions.question: If the difference between discount of 30% and two successive discounts of 20% on a certain bill is Rs. 42, then what is the amount of the bill?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Difference = Rs. 42

**Formula Used:**

SP = MRP × (1 - D%/100)

where, SP → Selling price, MRP → Marked price

**Calculations:**

Let the marked price be ‘x’

After 30% discount, Selling Price (SP) = x - 0.3x = 0.7x

After successive 20% discount, SP = x × 0.8 × 0.8 = 0.64x

According to question, 0.7x - 0.64x = 42

⇒ 0.06x = 42

⇒ x = 42/0.06 = Rs. 700

**∴ The amount of bill = Rs. 700.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Successive discount = D% + d% - (D% × d%)/100

2 successive discounts of 20% = 20% + 20% - (20% × 20%)/100 

⇒ 2 successive discounts of 20% = 36%

Now, (36 - 30)% = Rs. 42

⇒100% = Rs. 42 × (100%/6%)

⇒ 100% = Rs. 700

∴ The amount of bill = Rs. 700.

questions.question: If a shopkeeper marks the price of goods 40% more than their cost price and allows a discount of 30%, then what is his gain or loss percent?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be x

Marked Price = x + 0.4x = 1.4x

Selling Price = 1.4x - 0.3 × 1.4x = 0.98x

∵ Selling Price is less than Cost Price → Loss

∴ Loss % = [(Cost Price - Selling Price)/Cost Price] × 100 = [(x - 0.98x)/x] × 100 = 2% loss

questions.question: Incomes of X and Y are in the ratio of 5 : 3. Their expenditures are in the ratio 9 : 5. If both save Rs. 1600 at the end of the month, then what is the income of X?
questions.solution:
Let the incomes of X and Y be 5p and 3p respectively.

Let the expenditures of X and Y be 9q and 5q respectively.

Given, 5p - 9q = 1600 and 3p - 5q = 1600

⇒ 5p - 9q = 3p - 5q

⇒ 2p = 4q

∴ p = 2q

Substituting p’s value in any one of the equations

⇒ 5 × 2q - 9q = 1600

⇒ q = 1600

⇒ p = 3200

∴ Income of X = 5 × 3200 = Rs. 16000

questions.question: A sold a cycle to B at a profit of 20%. B sold the cycle to C at a profit of 30%. If C pays Rs. 468 for cycle, then for how much A bought the cycle?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A to B = 20% Profit for A

B to C = 30% Profit for B

Selling Price for B = Rs 468

**FORMULA USED:**

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Gain%

**CALCULATION:**

Let Cost Price of cycle be x

⇒ Selling Price by A = x + 0.2x = 1.2x 

⇒ Selling Price by B = 1.2x + 0.3 × 1.2x = 1.56x 

⇒ 1.56x = 468

∴ x = 468/1.56 = Rs. 300

questions.question: By selling an article for Rs. 360 there is a loss of 10%. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of the article = Rs 360

Loss = 10%

**Formula used:**

C.P = S.P × 100/(100 - L%)

Where,

C.P = cost price

S.P = selling price

L% = Loss percent

**Calculation:**

C.P = S.P × 100/(100 - L%)

⇒ 360 × 100/(100 - 10)

⇒ 360 × 100/90

⇒ 400

**∴ The cost price of the article is Rs 400**

questions.question: A number is increased first by 20% and then it is decreased by 10%. What is the percentage change in the number?

The speed of a boat in still water is 8 km/hr. It covers a distance of 52 km upstream in 8 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the stream?

questions.question: In how much time will Rs. 9000 amount to Rs. 13500 at simple interest at the rate of 5% per annum?

Simple interest = (P × r × t)/100,

P = principal,

t = time period and

r = rate of interest.

⇒ 4500 = (9000 × 5 × t)/100

⇒ 4500 = 450t

∴ t = 4500/450 = 10 years
